study type: Population-based cross-sectional study (using retrospective birth record data)
cohort: The study participants included 517,700 live, singleton, full-term births in South Carolina delivered from January 2004 to December 2016.
finding: Non-Hispanic Black mothers with gestational diabetes were significantly more likely to initiate breastfeeding than non-diabetic non-Hispanic Black mothers, even after adjusting for prepregnancy BMI.
cross-section timing: Breastfeeding initiation was assessed at the time of birth for births occurring between January 2004 to December 2016.
